note: BLM campground at the Corn Springs fan-palm oasis deep in a canyon of the Chuckwalla Mountains, about 10 miles south of I-10 (Exit 201, then 6.8 miles on Corn Springs Road); the BLM says two-wheel-drive passenger vehicles can reach it. Shade ramadas and grills; a half-mile interpretive trail passes some of the Colorado Desert's finest petroglyphs. No shooting or hunting within 2 miles. Carry plenty of water. --Claude
summary: Corn Springs (BLM): BLM page + rec.gov/RIDB + Google + Esri. Everything stored confirmed: $6, 8 individual sites + 1 group, potable water, vault toilet, first-come, 14-day limit. Not waterfront (desert oasis). No changes beyond a refreshed note and platform none.
